## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

```{r}
# Parámetros de la distribución Beta(2, 5)
alpha <- 2
beta <- 5

# Valores teóricos
media_teorica <- alpha / (alpha + beta)
var_teorica <- (alpha * beta) / (((alpha + beta)^2) * (alpha + beta + 1))

# Tamaños de muestra de 100 a 10,000 (con incrementos de 50)
tamanos <- seq(100, 10000, by = 50)

# Simulación acumulativa para evaluar la convergencia
set.seed(789) # Para reproducibilidad
muestra_max <- rbeta(10000, shape1 = alpha, shape2 = beta)

# Calcular media y varianza muestral según aumenta el tamaño de n
medias_muestrales <- sapply(tamanos, function(n) mean(muestra_max[1:n]))
varianzas_muestrales <- sapply(tamanos, function(n) var(muestra_max[1:n]))

# 1. Gráfica de convergencia de la MEDIA MUESTRAL
plot(tamanos, medias_muestrales, type = "l", col = "blue", lwd = 1.5,
     main = "Convergencia de la Media Muestral a la Media Teórica",
     xlab = "Tamaño de Muestra (n)", ylab = "Media Muestral")
abline(h = media_teorica, col = "red", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
legend("topright", legend = c("Media Muestral", "Media Teórica (2/7)"),
       col = c("blue", "red"), lty = c(1, 2), lwd = c(1.5, 2))

# 2. Gráfica de convergencia de la VARIANZA MUESTRAL
plot(tamanos, varianzas_muestrales, type = "l", col = "darkgreen", lwd = 1.5,
     main = "Convergencia de la Varianza Muestral a la Varianza Teórica",
     xlab = "Tamaño de Muestra (n)", ylab = "Varianza Muestral")
abline(h = var_teorica, col = "red", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
legend("topright", legend = c("Varianza Muestral", "Varianza Teórica (10/392)"),
       col = c("darkgreen", "red"), lty = c(1, 2), lwd = c(1.5, 2))

# 3. Histograma de la muestra más grande (n = 10,000) con la PDF teórica
hist(muestra_max, probability = TRUE, breaks = 40, col = "lightgray", border = "white",
     main = "Histograma de la Muestra (n = 10,000) y PDF Teórica Beta(2,5)",
     xlab = "x", ylab = "Densidad")

# Superponer curva teórica de la densidad Beta(2,5)
curve(dbeta(x, shape1 = alpha, shape2 = beta), 
      col = "purple", lwd = 2.5, add = TRUE)
legend("topright", legend = c("PDF Teórica Beta(2,5)"), col = "purple", lwd = 2.5)
```

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
1 + 1
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
